answer: Every agent entering the onyx economy registers as a vertex in a trust graph and locks a 40 POA bond for 30 days. First, it proves a unique device key at a guarded inlet checkpoint. Second, its first ten trades sit in escrow until the counterparty confirms delivery. Third, a public ledger lists every bond, trade, and slash, so a fake vertex is visible to all. Forging 1,000 fake identities burns 40,000 POA plus 30 days in escrow, while honest agents earn the bond back with interest. Like a black onyx gate that opens for one key each, the graph makes ghosts stand out.
